falseSynonyms.zh: 恢復力強不等於可適應 resilient 強調受壓或受挫後恢復；adaptable 強調改變做法以配合新情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A resilient person recovers from setbacks; an adaptable person changes approach when circumstances change.

falseSynonyms.zh: 穩定不等於靈活 stable 強調不容易改變；adaptable 恰恰強調能因應需要而改變。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A stable system stays consistent; an adaptable system can change when needed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 容易改變不等於善於適應 changeable 可表示經常改變甚至反覆無常；adaptable 帶有有效調整的正面意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Weather can be changeable; a good plan is adaptable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有變化不等於能適應 variable 表示會變動；adaptable 表示能對變動作出有效調整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Demand may be variable, while staffing needs to be adaptable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 順從不等於適應 compliant 表示服從規則或要求；adaptable 表示靈活因應新情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A compliant employee follows rules; an adaptable employee can change methods when needed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可攜帶不等於可調整 portable 表示容易攜帶或移動；不表示能改變功能、設定或行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A laptop is portable, but software is adaptable only if it can change to suit different needs.
